jobs.instruction: On the white position strip, remove the short graduation tick marks to the left of every numeral so each value reads with a single minus sign (−1 … −8, not '--1'); keep every numeral, the equal spacing, the brass pointer tab at 0, the −2 card, the −2 window and everything else unchanged.
Move the painted blue-and-gold lamp picture from the front face of the top supply box onto that box's top lid; keep it the only picture, wordless; change nothing else.
